context_varying_parameters.name: age_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: Distinct age eligibility and source marginal evidence require different distributions. MIND uses moment-derived bounded beta; Ayele uses category and moment-derived conditional betas; target uses an assumption-defined unbounded-above shifted gamma. No target age distribution is supplied.

context_varying_parameters.name: female_composition
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source sample compositions use their reported counts; target probability 0.55 is an explicit scenario choice, not an estimated target frequency.

context_varying_parameters.name: bmi_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND moments, Ayele category counts and unreported target BMI margins support different marginal families/settings. Category interior shapes and target moments remain assumptions.

context_varying_parameters.name: glucose_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: Only MIND has a continuous glucose margin. Its arithmetic central scale is a limited target anchor; Ayele glucose and target broader dispersion are declared assumptions before differing observation layers.

context_varying_parameters.name: measurement
context_varying_parameters.reason: Overnight fasting serum, three-day capillary averaging, and pooled target capillary POC are distinct recorded-value contexts. Added feeding, scale, and error settings are explicit uncalibrated assumptions; MIND is the observed-marginal reference with no added noise.

context_varying_parameters.name: sex_shifts
context_varying_parameters.reason: Sex composition does not identify sex differences in BMI or glucose. Context shifts allow assumed population differences while exact mixture ranks preserve the selected marginal laws.
